latest.title: Gen Zers quit their jobs to start a pickle company—now it’s valued at $8.5 million
latest.description: Good Girl Snacks founders Leah Marcus and Yasaman Bakhitar built their startup's multimillion-dollar valuation with pickle jars and Gen Z branding strategies.

latest.title: Goodyear burning rubber and cash as turnaround plan continues
latest.description: The tire maker has an ongoing turnaround plan as the company tries to restructure its business, refinance and pay down years of debt.

latest.title: Tokenized assets are busier than the data shows
latest.description: When you strip out what was never mobile, correct for who's holding what and why, add back what works off-contract, the utilization of tokenized assets looks close to 20%, argues Katana’s Matthew Fisher.

latest.title: K, C or E? Why economists can’t agree on the shape of today’s economy
latest.description: Economists have long viewed the post-pandemic economy as "K"-shaped. That consensus has now evaporated.

latest.title: Tech backlash reaches fever pitch as AI angst collides with social media fears
latest.description: With data center concerns becoming a major election issue and Meta reaching a landmark settlement in a social media case, the tech backlash is gaining steam.

latest.title: Iran trade falls as Supreme Leader Khamenei urges less reliance on the U.S. dollar
latest.description: Iran's president says sanctions are hitting imports and exports, as its supreme leader urges less reliance on the U.S. dollar.

latest.title: Buffett remains active at 96, but Berkshire's shares aren't doing much
latest.description: Warren Buffett will be celebrating his 96th birthday on Sunday, but Berkshire Hathaway investors aren't celebrating the stock's anemic performance.

latest.title: Trump-promoted brand touts GOLD before token collapse
latest.description: Real Trump Coins promoted GOLD before deleting related X posts, while team-linked wallets sold 224.5 million tokens as its market value fell about 99%.

latest.title: Stablecoins not credible for payments at scale, BIS chief says
latest.description: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos said stablecoins lack credibility for payments at scale, while a new FSI study highlights sharp differences in issuer rules.

latest.title: Bitcoin ETFs end 9-day inflow streak as BTC dips below $78K
latest.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $201.8 million in net outflows Friday, led by ARK 21Shares, as total fund assets slipped back below $100 billion.

latest.title: Opinion: Dolly Parton was underestimated for decades. That became one of her greatest strengths
latest.description: In a candid 2015 interview, Dolly Parton told CNBC's Tania Bryer about depression, ambition and the business decisions that defined her career.

latest.title: Bitcoin wallets untouched for 10 years moved $40 million. Most avoided exchanges
latest.description: Six decade-old wallets moved $40 million this month, but Galaxy's data shows dormant coin activity at its lowest since 2022 and 2026 on pace for under half of last year's total.

latest.title: Mark Walter's insurer Delaware Life sees two banks pause sale of its products amid probes
latest.description: Walter's holding company earlier in the week said "there has been no fraud" at Delaware Life and its affiliated company, Clear Spring Life and Annuity.

latest.title: Ripple is preparing XRP Ledger for quantum computers before ‘Q-Day’ arrives
latest.description: An Anthropic model cut the work needed to break a leading post-quantum signature candidate by a factor of 67 million last month, while Bitcoin and Ethereum published their own migration plans this week.

latest.title: U.S. appeals court rules against prediction markets, sets up likely fight at Supreme Court
latest.description: The 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that sports-related event contracts are not swaps, contradicting a 3rd Circuit ruling from April.

latest.title: Trump announces deal with Venezuela to secure more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
latest.description: The U.S. struck a deal with Venezuela to get majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves, Trump said in a social media post.

latest.title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
latest.description: This latest U.S. appeals court ruling sets up a rift between federal courts on event contracts, suggesting the U.S. Supreme Court may need to settle the matter.

latest.title: Bitcoin Rally Stalls, But Long-Term Sentiment Remains Bullish
latest.description: BTC gave back some of its gains after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh talked tough on inflation, but prediction market traders are still leaning bullish.
